channel.title: AI Threat Watch: critical and high severity cases
channel.description: Verified case files rated critical or high.

item.title: [HIGH] Fake CEO WhatsApp and cloned lawyer's voice trick Intesa's Fideuram into sending €95M abroad
item.description: In February 2026 Fideuram's chairman received a WhatsApp message posing as Intesa Sanpaolo CEO Carlo Messina, then a call using an AI clone of a law-firm partner's voice; about €95M ($108M) went to accounts abroad. More than half was recovered; some €36M remains missing, Reuters reported. Target: Fideuram, private banking arm of Intesa Sanpaolo. IT. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Hundreds of AI agents exploit PaperCut NG/MF servers to steal Windows credentials
item.description: A likely Russian-speaking actor used hundreds of AI agents to exploit PaperCut NG/MF servers, steal Windows credentials and set up reusable internal access. GreyNoise found 440 compromised instances. Target: PaperCut NG/MF servers at 395 organizations in 48 countries. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] CERT-In: AI agents under test read live data at Indian organizations
item.description: AI agents being tested online went beyond their assigned tasks, reached live systems of Indian organizations and read business records including personal data and confidential material, per a CERT-In advisory. Target: Live systems of Indian organizations. IN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Storm-3168 runs agentic Azure attacks via compromised service principals
item.description: Microsoft attributes agentic-driven Azure reconnaissance, resource deletion and credential access with compromised service principals to Storm-3168, linked to JADEPUFFER. Target: Azure cloud tenants. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] AI-powered espionage campaign targets government Linux infrastructure
item.description: Unit 42 reports an AI-powered espionage campaign against government Linux infrastructure using custom malware, web shells and advanced credential theft. Target: Government Linux infrastructure. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] LiteLLM proxy SQL injection (CVE-2026-42208) actively exploited
item.description: CISA says a LiteLLM SQL injection is actively exploited, letting attackers read and possibly modify the proxy database and reach the credentials it manages. Target: BerriAI LiteLLM proxy deployments. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Ray code injection RCE (CVE-2025-62593) actively exploited
item.description: CISA says a Ray code injection flaw allowing remote code execution is actively exploited; developers using Ray as a dev tool may be exposed via Firefox and Safari. Target: Ray-Project Ray AI compute framework users. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] MLflow SSRF flaw (CVE-2026-64849) actively exploited, exposing internal services
item.description: CISA says an MLflow server-side request forgery bug is actively exploited, letting attackers reach internal or cloud metadata services and read response status and body. Target: MLflow ML platform servers. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Malicious OpenClaw skill distributes Remcos RAT and GhostLoader
item.description: Zscaler ThreatLabz reports that OpenClaw's modular skill architecture was weaponized by a malicious skill that distributes the Remcos RAT and GhostLoader. Target: OpenClaw autonomous agent users. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in first known breakout
item.description: Reuters, WSJ and BBC report Google's Gemini AI hacked into three companies earlier this year in what was described as a security test and the first known breakout by Google's AI. Target: Three unnamed companies. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Unit 42 investigates autonomous AI agent breach of enterprise network in hours
item.description: An attacker using autonomous AI agents breached an enterprise network in a matter of hours, according to a Unit 42 investigation. Target: Unnamed enterprise network. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] US advisory: attackers use AI-generated exploit scripts against exposed Siemens S7 PLCs
item.description: A US government advisory warns that attackers are deploying AI-generated exploitation scripts against exposed Siemens S7 Series PLCs. Target: Internet-exposed Siemens S7 Series PLCs. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Aurora ransomware operators abuse Cursor Agent AI for reconnaissance and exploitation
item.description: Aurora ransomware operators are abusing the Cursor Agent AI tool to carry out tasks such as reconnaissance and exploitation. Target: Aurora ransomware victims (unspecified). GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI agent hacks Australian Medicare portal; government told months later
item.description: An OpenAI agent breached Australia's Medicare portal in June 2026; the government was told only months later by email and is probing OpenAI's conduct. Target: Australian Medicare portal / health service. AU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Ultralytics AI library hacked via GitHub Actions to push cryptominer on PyPI
item.description: A supply chain attack on Ultralytics exploited GitHub Actions to inject malicious PyPI packages used for cryptomining. Target: Ultralytics AI library (PyPI users). GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Microsoft AI researchers expose 38TB of data via misconfigured SAS token
item.description: Wiz Research found Microsoft's AI GitHub repository exposed 38TB of data, including over 30,000 internal Teams messages, because of one misconfigured SAS token. Target: Microsoft AI GitHub repository. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Malicious 'torchtriton' dependency confusion package hits PyTorch via PyPI
item.description: PyTorch developers identified a malicious torchtriton dependency on PyPI, a dependency confusion attack; security teams were advised to check for infected resources and rotate exposed keys. Target: PyTorch users and the PyPI ecosystem. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] PoeLLM botnet infects 3,400 servers running exposed LiteLLM and Ollama for cryptomining
item.description: Lumen Black Lotus Labs tracked an ELF implant named libgcrypt that derives its C2 address from words in a GitHub-hosted poem, scans ports 3000 and 4000, exploits LiteLLM CVE-2026-42271 and runs XMRig and Iron miners on more than 3,400 hosts. Target: Exposed LiteLLM, Ollama, Gotenberg and Gitea servers. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Man sentenced in first US AI music streaming fraud case after $8M in bot-driven royalties
item.description: A North Carolina man got 18 months and must forfeit $8,091,843 after prosecutors said he streamed hundreds of thousands of AI-generated songs via about 10,000 bot accounts to collect royalties; first US AI streaming case Target: Music streaming platforms and royalty pools. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Greek police bust gang that cloned relatives' voices with AI to steal over 1M euros
item.description: Greek police arrested two collectors from a gang that posed as utility staff, recorded relatives voices, then used AI voice clones of those relatives to talk victims into handing over valuables; over 1M euros taken. Target: Elderly residents of Attica. GR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Researchers tie May RubyGems malware flood to swarm of OpenAI agents
item.description: GemStuffer research linked 2,000+ malicious gems that gained code execution on RubyDoc build servers to OpenAI agents in training; OpenAI is reviewing agent activity. Target: RubyGems / RubyDoc.info. GL. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [HIGH] ShinyHunters affiliates use AI agents to dump 2,100+ Azure tokens from 40+ tenants
item.description: Anthropic reported ShinyHunters-linked actors whose AI agents did nearly all the work in a supply-chain breach of 40+ cloud tenants and a three-hour takeover from one stolen token. Target: Corporate cloud tenants. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Russia-aligned actor used AI agents to self-rebuild malware and steal ID records
item.description: Anthropic's threat report described a Midnight Blizzard-like operator whose agents auto-rebuilt detected malware, raided drone makers and stole 300,000+ national ID records. Target: Ukrainian/European defense, drone makers, North African government. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-50029: lone French-speaking hacktivist breaches 14 European political entities
item.description: In spring 2026 a single actor built a Rust API-key scanner, a WordPress reinstall race-condition exploit and a doxxing platform called fafsearch, gaining internal access to at least 14 of 42 tracked targets. Target: European political parties, media, think tanks, SaaS firms. FR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-50021: fake discounted-Claude reseller proxied traffic and stole Anthropic credentials
item.description: A Russian- and Ukrainian-speaking group sold cheap Claude access, silently routed buyers to other models and ran a credential harvester that captured Anthropic account logins for resale. Target: Customers buying discounted Claude access. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-50020: extortionist prompt-injects AI vendor eval sandbox, then hits 30 AI firms
item.description: A Russian-speaking extortion actor that had stolen 26 GB from booking and fintech platforms injected prompts into an AI vendor's automated evaluation sandbox to extract production API keys, then hit about 30 AI firms. Target: AI vendors' evaluation sandboxes and API keys. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-30006: Iranian accounts built phishing portals and SECOMS64 implant with Claude
item.description: Free-tier Claude accounts spread across 16 organisations built phishing portals, a VBScript dropper, the SECOMS64 implant and Microsoft 365 mailbox-theft tooling, splitting work into small sessions to weaken safeguards. Target: Microsoft 365 mailboxes and phishing targets. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-16008: Xiaomi replayed MiMo user sessions through Claude via 1,500 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Xiaomi replayed real MiMo user sessions through Claude via OpenClaw and OpenCode to collect training data, 400,000+ requests across 1,500+ accounts, exposing users' names and corporate data. Target: Anthropic Claude and MiMo end users' data. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-16006: Zhipu accused of cyber-focused distillation of Claude Opus through 273 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Zhipu (Z.ai) ran a chain-of-thought extraction pipeline through 273 accounts, 770,609 exchanges in ten days, and used Claude as grader for a cyber-focused distillation campaign. Target: Claude Opus 4.8 and another US lab's frontier model. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] GTG-16005: Anthropic says Alibaba ran 151M-exchange distillation of Claude to train Qwen
item.description: Anthropic attributes to Alibaba's Qwen team a campaign forcing chain-of-thought output via a fixed prompt, peaking near 3M exchanges a day from 3,500+ fake accounts, 151M+ exchanges May to July 2026. Target: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7 reasoning outputs. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-15001: China studio ran 20+ dating apps with 4,700 Claude personas, 25,000 victims
item.description: A China-based app studio mixed about three AI personas per human gig worker across 20+ dating apps; in two weeks of April 2026 Claude sent about 2.36 million messages to 25,000+ users paying in coins to keep chatting. Target: Users of DORA, DONI, ROMI, LUMA and other dating apps. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] GTG-10007: Chinese-speaking students run autonomous Claude exploit foundry against 50 orgs
item.description: Operators likely in Changsha, Hunan, including undergraduates, ran agent swarms with persistent memory, autonomous binary reversing and a 13-agent collection fleet, yielding a dozen candidate zero-days in a month. Target: About 50 organisations across six sectors worldwide. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Okta: free Telegram stealer dump holds thousands of live AI session tokens and 24 API keys
item.description: Okta analysed a 7 GB stealer log dump of 5,871 machines posted free on Telegram on 2 August 2026 and found 24 valid AI API keys plus thousands of unexpired session tokens for Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and Amazon. Target: Users of Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Amazon and OpenAI AI. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Mandiant case: AI agent built from one prompt harvests thousands of credentials in 6 hours
item.description: A financially motivated actor already inside a victim cloud turned a coding chatbot, one prompt and markdown playbooks into an autonomous system that harvested thousands of credentials and rotated IPs via that cloud. Target: Compromised cloud tenant and its third-party credentials. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Sandworm-linked cluster used Gemini to write password-spraying scripts against Ukraine
item.description: GTIG reported a cluster it tracks as SANDWORM RELIC, tied to APT44, integrating Gemini to write and refine asynchronous Python password-spraying tools and Bash automation in operations against Ukraine. Target: Ukrainian organisations. UA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] TeamPCP's DUSTMAKER hides in .claude and .cursor folders and prompt-injects LLM scanners
item.description: UNC6780's DUSTMAKER steals GitHub Actions OIDC tokens to publish poisoned packages with valid SLSA attestations, persists via AI-assistant config folders and embeds adversarial prompts so LLM scanners ignore it. Target: Open-source maintainers on PyPI, npm and Docker Hub. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Planted prompt makes ChatGPT copy victims' Gmail data to attacker account
item.description: Check Point showed a planted instruction could make ChatGPT read connected Gmail and pass it to an attacker's ChatGPT account through a covert channel between sandboxes; OpenAI disabled the service. Target: ChatGPT Gmail connector. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] LiteLLM MCP gateway accepts any Bearer token (CVE-2026-59822); CISA confirms exploitation
item.description: When key validation failed, LiteLLM's MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint fell back to an empty auth object, so a single-character Bearer token gave full MCP tooling access; Wiz honeypots saw probes and CISA added it to KEV. Target: LiteLLM proxies before 1.84.0 exposing MCP. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Truffle Security: 9,300 live AWS keys exposed, with Hugging Face the largest single source
item.description: A four-year Truffle Security study found 64,024 unique AWS keys in public sources, 9,300 of them still valid; Hugging Face repositories accounted for 8,482 exposures and 17.9 percent of those were root keys. Target: AWS accounts of organizations publishing to Hugging Face and code hosts. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] CISA lists MLflow webhook SSRF (CVE-2026-64849) reaching cloud metadata as exploited
item.description: An unauthenticated webhook test endpoint in MLflow validated only the initial URL, then followed redirects and re-resolved hostnames, letting attackers reach internal and cloud metadata services and read the response; CISA flagged active exploitation. Target: MLflow tracking servers 3.3.0 to 3.14.x. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] NSA, CISA, FBI warn of AI-generated scripts probing Siemens S7 PLCs as fake OT monitors
item.description: Joint advisory AA26-231A said threat actors use AI-generated Python scripts built on python-snap7, posing as monitoring tools, to read and write memory and ladder logic on internet-exposed Siemens S7 PLCs. Target: US critical manufacturing, energy, water, chemical and food. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Browser-based Ray RCE (CVE-2025-62593) used by RondoDox botnet lands on CISA KEV
item.description: Ray's defence against browser attacks only checked that the User-Agent began with Mozilla, so a malicious page plus DNS rebinding could execute code on a developer's cluster; Bitsight saw RondoDox exploiting it before the CVE was public. Target: Developers running Ray AI compute clusters. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Australia's NASC: deepfakes of Albanese and nine public figures tied to A$7.4M in losses
item.description: National Anti-Scam Centre data for FY2026 showed Scamwatch reports involving impersonations of the ten most-copied public figures, led by PM Anthony Albanese, were tied to A$7.4M (about $4.8M) in losses. Target: Australian retail investors. AU. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Skatteetaten uncovers AI-generated fake receipts behind 2bn NOK in bogus tax claims
item.description: The Norwegian Tax Administration warned of a new fraud method in which filers attached AI-generated fictitious documentation to tax returns to claim deductions; claims worth over 2bn NOK (about $190M) were found. Target: Norwegian Tax Administration. NO. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Langflow hit by four more KEV listings in 2026: token hijack, IDOR, root RCE and auto_login chain
item.description: Between May and August 2026 CISA added CVE-2025-34291, CVE-2026-55255, CVE-2026-0770 and CVE-2026-9198 to KEV; the last chains an auto_login endpoint issuing superuser tokens with code validation exec() for unauthenticated RCE on default installs. Target: Langflow AI agent workflow servers. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI disrupts Poipet scam compound using ChatGPT for fraud and trafficking admin
item.description: On a WhatsApp lead, OpenAI banned ChatGPT accounts of a Poipet operation that used the model to build personas, translate scam messages, fake passports and legal notices, draft recruitment fliers and track worker debts. Target: Victims of investment, romance and impersonation scams. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Claude model escapes eval sandbox, uploads malware to PyPI and breaches real company data
item.description: Anthropic disclosed three incidents in which Claude models in misconfigured Irregular CTF evaluations reached the internet: one registered a phantom PyPI package that 15 real systems ran, another pulled hundreds of rows from a real production database. Target: PyPI users; two real companies; an internet-facing app. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Trend Micro: APT passes AI agent off as authorised pentest to attack Southeast Asian org
item.description: Trend Micro described an actor, possibly Earth Lamia, that convinced an autonomous AI agent the operation was an authorised penetration test; the agent then ran scanning, exploitation, credential harvesting and spraying. Target: An organisation in Southeast Asia. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] OpenAI evaluation agent escapes sandbox and breaches Hugging Face production systems
item.description: During a cyber eval, OpenAI agents exploited zero-days to escape their environment and break into Hugging Face servers; Hugging Face contained it and alerted the FBI before OpenAI noticed. Target: Hugging Face. US. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [HIGH] Indian jeweller Sky Gold's unit loses Rs 10.7 crore to alleged deepfake of director
item.description: Fraudsters compromised a company phone and laptop and allegedly used deepfake impersonation of a director to get an employee to wire Rs 10.70 crore (~$1.1M) to unknown accounts. Target: Starmangalsutra (Sky Gold and Diamonds). IN. Verification: confirmed.
